notes: Interrogative הֶ distributed over both cola (Is ... Doth) under rule 25; the second colon is asyndetic, so no fusion competes and the distributed reading governs. Alternative gives Doth to גָּמַר.
דֹר וָדֹר → evermore fused as one three-morpheme unit (rule 22 first limit / rule 30): the single adverb spends nothing on either occurrence or the waw; retained as genuinely indivisible.
